title: Private Hospitals Association (Jordan) - member hospitals by region
notes: Member tables from the region pages (Amman, Zarqa, Irbid, Madaba, Karak, Aqaba, Mafraq); robots.txt allows these paths; 1 request/s. Columns: Arabic name, English name, Tel, Fax, Email, Website. Undated - the pages carry no last-updated date, and some entries are clearly old (Al Bayader and Al Razi Modern are listed although the MoH 2024 report marks both closed; Palestine Hospital listed separately from Al Bayader). "governorate" is the region page the hospital is listed under. Phones are the source digits prefixed with "+" (no reformatting); one fax (AlJazeera) has a digit missing in the source. 10 email addresses that are named individuals (e.g. firstname.lastname@...) were dropped as personal data; generic/departmental addresses kept. Some websites are malformed in the source (www.abdalihospitalcom, www.alharamain.hospital.com, www.ammnhospital.com) and Al Mowasat lists an MSF Paris address/site - kept verbatim, verify before use. Abdali and Istiklal rows share data quirks (Istiklal lists the Istishari email). Ownership not stated by the source (membership is open to private hospitals; KHCC, Maqased and Italian are non-profits) so it is left empty. Skipped "Other Members" page (not hospitals): Jordan hearingTec / الشركة الاردنية لتكنولوجيا السمع. The site claims 58 members; 57 hospital rows are published (Amman numbering repeats 40).
